title: Beqata maara Gaya SIbte
body:
Ya Hassan
x6
<<MINI>>
Bay Khata Mara gaya Sibte Rasool-e-dosara wa Hassan-e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<DIVIDER>>
x3
1. Zehr se tukre jigar, khoon say kafan laal huwa
Wa Hassan-e-sabz-e-qaba
<<MINI>>
Be Khata Mara gaya Sibte Rasool-e-dosara wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
2. Khun ugalte huwe bhayi ko behan ne dekha or tarap ker ye kaha
x2
Teri gurbat pe ay bhayi teri Zainab ho fidaa wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<MINI>>
Be Khata Mara gaya Sibte Rasool-e-dosara wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
3. Maa ke dukh se abhi azad kahan thi zainab
hogaya kaisa gazab
x2
Baap zinda na raha Bhayi suwe khuld gaya wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<MINI>>
Be Khata Mara gaya Sibte Rasool-e-dosara wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
4. Ker diya Zahr-e-hala hal ne Jigar ke tukre Aur Qasim ke liye
x2
Kamsini me hai ye gham Sham-e-gharibi jaisa wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<MINI>>
Be Khata Mara gaya Sibte Rasool-e-dosara wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
5. Ghar se ik baar janaza jo nikal jata hai
kab wo phir aata hain
x2
Aisa taboot hai ye lot ke jo ghar ayaa wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<MINI>>
Be Khata Mara gaya Sibte Rasool-e-dosara wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
6. Sheh ne us wakht jo Ghazi ko na roka hota
hashr ho jata bapaa
x2
teer aate na janaze pe tumhare Maula wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<MINI>>
Be Khata Mara gaya Sibte Rasool-e-dosara wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
7. Bhai ki laash pe ghazi  ne tadap kar dekha aur sarwar se kaha X2times
Ab to dedijiye aaqa mujhe ladne ki rizaa wa hasan e sabz qaba
8. Sheh ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Rehan
baraadar kaa jigar yaad aya
jab se karbobala
x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tukde Qassim ke utha te huwe maula ne kaha wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<MINI>>
Be Khata Mara gaya Sibte Rasool-e-dosara wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-Qaba
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
